description:
¿Por qué no deberías limpiarte los oídos con un palito de algodón? Porque la cera sale sola, y el palito la empuja hacia adentro.
Vuelta tras vuelta, arma un tapón contra el tímpano. 👂
Envíaselo a ese amigo que se limpia los oídos con un palito apenas sale de la ducha.

scenes.name: hook
scenes.narration: ¿Por qué no deberías limpiarte los oídos con un palito de algodón? Parece que la cera es mugre que hay que sacar.
scenes.what_changes: A stylised outer ear with its canal shown in section on the cream plate; amber wax lines the canal near the opening; a cotton swab approaches; tag ¿MUGRE? hangs on the wax.
scenes.transformation: oído tranquilo con cera → se acerca el palito a sacarla
scenes.camera: órbita desde la oreja hacia la entrada del conducto

elements.name: ear canal cross-section with wax
elements.route: library candidate: Sketchfab 'Ear Anatomy' by brianj.seely (a6a44a28, CC-BY, 48k faces, a section through outer ear, canal and eardrum; thumbnail seen 2026-11-11; textures realistic: retint stylised, no skin texture; check for a brand watermark in the model); wax as an amber waxy material
elements.risk: medium: a canal section reads as 'ear anatomy'; the outer ear is the cue

elements.name: cotton swab
elements.route: library Sketchfab 'Cotton Swab' by amhyde (55e6fe76, CC-BY, 1.5k faces; thumbnail seen) or a geometric build

scenes.name: cinta
scenes.narration: Pero la cera te protege: atrapa el polvo en la entrada, y sale sola, porque la piel del oído crece hacia afuera, como una cinta lenta.
scenes.what_changes: Push-through into the canal: dust specks drifting in stick to the wax at the entrance; then the canal skin moves outward like a slow conveyor, carrying the wax and the trapped dust to the opening, where it falls away.
scenes.transformation: polvo que entra → queda pegado en la cera y la piel lo saca hacia afuera
scenes.camera: travelling a lo largo del conducto, del tímpano hacia la salida
overlays_plan: label CINTA tag with leader at 'cinta'

elements.name: wax moving out along the ear canal
elements.route: ear asset section + wax material on a moving skin layer (UV scroll)

scenes.name: palito
scenes.narration: Ahora entra el palito. Saca un poco de la orilla, pero empuja el resto hacia adentro, donde la piel ya no lo puede sacar.
scenes.what_changes: The swab goes in: its cotton tip skims a little wax from the edge and pushes the rest deeper, packing it toward the eardrum against the outward flow.
scenes.transformation: cera cerca de la salida → el palito la empuja hacia el fondo
scenes.camera: seguimiento del palito entrando por el conducto

elements.name: cotton swab inside the ear canal
elements.route: swab asset/build inside the ear section
elements.risk: low-medium: the swab is the cue; the canal is the context

scenes.name: tapon
scenes.narration: Vuelta tras vuelta, se forma un tapón contra el tímpano. Por eso los médicos piden no meter nada en el oído.
scenes.what_changes: The turn: repeated swab passes build a dense amber plug pressed against the eardrum; sound rings arriving from outside now hit the plug and stop before the eardrum, which stays dark; the plug takes a red mark.
scenes.transformation: cera suelta → un tapón compacto contra el tímpano que frena el sonido
scenes.camera: empuje hasta el tímpano y retroceso cuando rebota el sonido

elements.name: earwax plug against the eardrum
elements.route: wax material packed as a plug in the ear section; sound as emissive rings (doctrine energy language, as in 018)
elements.risk: medium-high: a plug in a canal may read as an abstract blob; the eardrum and canal are the cue

scenes.name: cierre
scenes.narration: Así que la cera no es mugre: es una cinta que se limpia sola, y el palito la atasca. Envíaselo a ese amigo que se limpia los oídos con un palito apenas sale de la ducha.
scenes.what_changes: Single reframe image: the plug dissolves back into a thin layer and the canal's slow conveyor carries the wax out again on its own, while the swab withdraws.
scenes.transformation: tapón → la cera vuelve a salir sola por la cinta de piel
scenes.camera: retroceso desde el conducto hasta la oreja entera

sources: Earwax protects the canal (traps dust and debris, lubricates) and the ear is self-cleaning: AAO-HNSF Clinical Practice Guideline (Update): Earwax (Cerumen Impaction), Schwartz et al., Otolaryngol Head Neck Surg 2017;156(1_suppl):S1-S29, and its press release / fact sheet (live search 2026-11-11). FLAGGED: quote the guideline's protective-role sentence at the beat sheet.

Self-cleaning by epithelial migration outward, helped by jaw movement: ink-dot study, 'Epithelial migration on the external ear canal wall in normal and pathologic ears', Otology & Neurotology 2011;32:504-507 (normal ears 42-205 µm/day); jaw-movement aid per clinician summaries (live search 2026-11-11). No rate is spoken or shown.
Cotton-tipped swabs push wax deeper and are advised against; not inserting objects is advised: same 2017 guideline (verified via its chair's statements and the guideline summary).
No number is spoken or rendered in this script.
simplifications: The canal is a stylised section; wax and the skin's migration are enlarged and sped up.
Sound is drawn as rings, as in 018; it is invisible.
